history.summary: 1,151sf 3BR at Castle Green (1997, 99LH, ~67yr left, 664 units, D26 Yio Chu Kang Rd, ~7-min walk to Lentor TE5) asking $1.71M / $1,486psf. The same 1,152sf layout has cleared at $1.50-1.68M over the last 12 months (Aug-26 $1.629M fl 01-05, Apr-26 $1.66M fl 01-05, Mar-26 $1.60M fl 06-10, Dec-25 $1.68M fl 06-10, Nov-25 $1.50M fl 01-05), so fair is ~$1.60-1.65M and this ask is ~4-7% over it with floor undisclosed. Carry is thin (~1.9% net on $4,400/mo, 21 contracts) and the lease is ~60yr at a 7-yr exit, where CPF/loan limits start to thin the buyer pool.
history.rating_rationale: Avoid at $1.71M: it's overpriced against this exact layout's own recent prints. The last five 1,152sf resales (Nov-25 to Aug-26) ran $1.50-1.68M, median ~$1.63M, and the newest is $1.629M in Aug-26. So the ask is ~$50-110k (4-7%) over fair, with floor undisclosed and no discount case to offset it. The algo flags the same thing (ask_above_own_stack_prints, +11% vs n=18 same-size prints over a longer window; score_1000 548 = market-typical). Carry doesn't compensate: 3.1% gross / ~1.9% net. Downside evidence is only middling: REALSCORE 3.9, 77.1% profitable, 6.4%/yr avg annualised on 597 resale pairs, so almost a quarter of matched resales lost money. That's a deep, real sample, not noise. The 67yr lease will be ~60yr by a 5-7yr exit, where CPF-usage and loan-quantum rules start to shrink the next buyer pool. The 7.3% ura_5yr_cagr is bull-regime trailing return (momentum −0.45 already rolling over) and is not credited forward. This would be a fair Neutral at ≤~$1.62M, in line with the Aug-26 print. Even at that price, the lease runway limits it to an average OCR hold rather than a Buy.

history.summary: 1,410 sqft 4BR at Castle Green (D26, 99LH from Dec-1993, TOP 1997, 664 units, ~7-min walk to Lentor TEL) asking $2.25M / $1,596 psf. The ask sits ABOVE every same-size print ever recorded (last three: $2.20M Sep-25, $2.15M Mar-26, $2.16M May-26, all floors 11-15) and ~19% above age-adjusted district peers, on a lease that drops below 60 years inside the hold window.
history.rating_rationale: Price, not the project, is the problem — and the lease makes the exit worse. Same-stack-size comps (1,410 sqft) printed $2.15-2.20M ($1,525-1,560 psf) over the last 12 months, all on floors 11-15; this ask ($1,596 psf, floor unknown) is 2-5% above the record and ~19% above age-adjusted D26 peers (relative_value), so there is no value cushion — the one signal that actually predicts forward returns points the wrong way. The lease commenced Dec-1993: ~66 yrs remain today and ~59-60 at a 6-7yr exit, where CPF use and bank LTV get pro-rated for older buyers — a real problem when realsmart shows 54% of buyers here are HDB upgraders (CPF-reliant). REALSCORE 3.9 on 597 resale pairs (77.1% profitable, 6.4%/yr avg) is decent downside evidence but 23% of resales lost money, and much of the recent 7%/yr CAGR is the Lentor new-launch halo (Lentor Modern/Hills/Mansion etc. at ~$2,200+ psf) — trailing, not forward. Gross yield 2.7% (URA 5 contracts) is thin carry. Four 1,410 sqft listings are live at $2.25-2.40M, and this one has already cut from $2.50M in two months, so the seller is moving toward the print band. Would turn Neutral near ~$2.1M ($1,490 psf) and only interesting below ~$2.0M. MMR 523 (market-typical) agrees it is not a standout.

agent_evaluation.appreciation_assessment: Model 7.34%/yr is a 5yr URA CAGR inflated by the 2021-25 bull run plus the Lentor new-launch halo; momentum is -0.45. Trailing CAGR has ~no forward power per the backtest. For a 66-yr lease crossing below 60 in the hold, I'd expect roughly district-typical or below (~2.5-3.5%/yr) with lease decay accelerating.
